sourceSite.location: sibling of design-repo/ (the folder that contains this design-repo); citations below are relative to it
sourceSite.stack: hand-written static HTML + plain CSS + vanilla JS, no build step, no package.json
sourceSite.mirrorOf: a live personal portfolio; the local copy self-hosts its two web fonts (Google Fonts @imports re-pointed to assets/fonts/*.css) and adds a local static server (serve.mjs, not part of the original).
